provenance_required: Real macOS TextEdit GUI save; no constructed fixtures

cases.instructions: Create several font-family runs with an installed font, RGB foreground colors, bold/italic, and different point sizes; save as an RTFD directory.
verify: Size and RGB foreground runs retained

cases.instructions: Insert two independent images, one with a Unicode or space-containing filename, between text including accented and emoji characters.
verify: Inline image ordering and positions preserved

cases.instructions: Set paragraph left/right indents, negative first-line indent, and left/center/right/decimal tab stops; include literal tabs.
verify: GTK and TextEdit visual alignment compared

cases.instructions: Use nested bullet and numbered lists, mixed indentation, and normal paragraphs before and after lists.
verify: Supported list kind and depth retained
Unsupported numbering styles documented, not invented

cases.instructions: Open an actual TextEdit-generated RTFD in Stickies, modify text styling and one image, export, open/save with TextEdit, and reimport.
verify: Original note and source package remain unchanged
New exported RTFD opens in TextEdit
No unexpected text, image or formatting losses
